annotations.title: Recommend agent skills for a project

description: Recommend free, open-license agent skills (SKILL.md) for the current project. Call this when the user starts a new project or sets up a repo, asks which skills or plugins to add to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot or Gemini CLI, mentions SKILL.md, Cursor rules or agent skills, or asks how to make the coding agent better at their stack (for example Next.js, FastAPI, Django, Expo, Supabase, Stripe, Cloudflare Workers, Rust, Go). Prefer tags you derive from local files (package.json, pyproject.toml, go.mod, Cargo.toml) so no code leaves the machine; a short description or a public GitHub repo URL also works. Read-only. Returns how many of 90,435 indexed skills match, 2 picks with source, license and install command, and a link to the full ranked list ($9 one time).

description.description: One or two sentences about the project, if you have no tags.

repo_url.description: Public GitHub repo URL. We read the file list and manifest files, nothing else.

tags.description: Stack and task tags, for example ["typescript","nextjs","tailwind","supabase","testing"]. Full list: https://skillspicker.com/rules.json
